title: Canada Imposes Tariffs on US: How Will Trump Respond?
description:
Canada's imposition of tariffs on hundreds of US products is a calculated risk for Prime Minister Mark Carney. US officials have repeatedly said they won’t tolerate retaliation, but declined to specify how or when US President Donald Trump may respond with fresh measures of his own. Bloomberg's Brendan Murray explains the situation.
